page_texts.3:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#decision-summary]

## Decision Summary

Establish Mermaid for UML diagrams and Draw.io for BPMN business process modeling as the standard diagram-as-code tools, with Draw.io diagrams saved in .drawio.png format for inline editing and Markdown embedding.

---
page_texts.5:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#business-context]

### Business Context

Enterprise Architecture documentation requires visual diagrams to communicate complex systems, processes, and relationships effectively. Current diagramming practices use various tools creating inconsistent outputs, poor version control, and limited AI accessibility for automated analysis and generation.
page_texts.6:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#technical-context]

### Technical Context

- Diagrams currently created in multiple tools (Visio, PowerPoint, Lucidchart, Draw.io)
- Binary formats difficult to version control and diff
- No standardized approach for diagram integration with documentation
- Limited ability for AI tools to generate or modify diagrams
- Inconsistent styling and notation across teams
page_texts.7:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#problem-statement]

### Problem Statement

How can diagramming tools and formats be standardized to enable version control, AI consumption, consistent styling, and seamless integration with Markdown documentation while supporting both technical (UML) and business process (BPMN) modeling needs?
page_texts.8:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#decision-drivers]

#### Decision Drivers

- **Diagram-as-Code**: Text-based diagram definitions for version control
- **AI Compatibility**: Enable AI generation and modification of diagrams
- **Tool Specialization**: Match diagram types to optimal tools
- **IDE Integration**: Inline editing capabilities within development environment
- **Markdown Embedding**: Seamless integration with documentation
- **Version Control**: Meaningful diffs and merge capabilities
- **Consistency**: Standardized styling and notation across organization

---
page_texts.10:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#dual-tool-diagram-as-code-standard]

### Dual-Tool Diagram-as-Code Standard

**Description**: Use Mermaid for UML diagrams and Draw.io for BPMN business process modeling, with standardized file formats and integration workflows.

**Mermaid Usage**:

- UML diagrams (class, sequence, activity, component)
- System architecture diagrams
- Entity relationship diagrams
- Flowcharts and decision trees

**Draw.io Usage**:

- BPMN business process diagrams
- Complex organizational charts
- Detailed infrastructure layouts
- Custom business diagrams requiring advanced layout

**File Format Standards**:

- Mermaid: `.mmd` text files embedded in Markdown
- Draw.io: `.drawio.png` format for dual-purpose files (editable + renderable)

**Pros**:

✅ **Tool Specialization**: Each tool optimized for specific diagram types
✅ **Version Control**: Text-based Mermaid and XML-based Draw.io both Git-friendly
✅ **AI Integration**: Mermaid easily generated by AI, Draw.io programmatically accessible
✅ **IDE Integration**: Draw.io extension enables inline editing of .drawio.png files
✅ **Markdown Native**: Mermaid renders directly in Markdown, Draw.io images embed seamlessly
✅ **Flexibility**: Covers full spectrum from simple UML to complex business processes
✅ **Open Standards**: Both tools use open formats preventing vendor lock-in

**Cons**:

❌ **Tool Learning**: Teams need to learn two different diagramming approaches
❌ **Workflow Complexity**: Different processes for different diagram types
❌ **Draw.io Dependency**: Requires specific IDE extension for inline editing

---
page_texts.12:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#option-1-mermaid-only-standard]

### Option 1: Mermaid-Only Standard

**Description**: Use Mermaid for all diagramming needs across the organization

**Pros**:

✅ **Simplicity**: Single tool and workflow to learn
✅ **Version Control**: Pure text-based format
✅ **AI Native**: Easily generated and modified by AI tools

**Cons**:

❌ **Limited BPMN**: Poor support for complex business process modeling
❌ **Layout Control**: Limited fine-grained positioning and styling options
❌ **Complex Diagrams**: Struggles with large, detailed architectural diagrams
page_texts.13:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#option-2-drawio-only-standard]

### Option 2: Draw.io-Only Standard

**Description**: Use Draw.io for all diagramming with .drawio.png format

**Pros**:

✅ **Feature Complete**: Supports all diagram types with rich formatting
✅ **Visual Editor**: WYSIWYG editing experience
✅ **Professional Output**: High-quality diagrams with fine control

**Cons**:

❌ **AI Generation**: More complex for AI tools to generate programmatically
❌ **Version Control**: XML format creates large diffs
❌ **Learning Curve**: More complex interface and features
page_texts.14:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#option-3-traditional-tool-continuation]

### Option 3: Traditional Tool Continuation

**Description**: Continue using existing tools (Visio, PowerPoint, Lucidchart) with improved standards

**Pros**:

✅ **Familiarity**: Teams already know these tools
✅ **Feature Rich**: Advanced capabilities for complex diagrams

**Cons**:

❌ **Binary Formats**: Poor version control and AI consumption
❌ **Tool Fragmentation**: Inconsistent outputs and licensing costs
❌ **Limited Automation**: Difficult to generate or modify programmatically

---
page_texts.15:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#decision-outcome]

## Decision Outcome

**Chosen Option**: **Dual-Tool Diagram-as-Code Standard** (Recommended Option)

**Rationale**: The combination of Mermaid and Draw.io provides optimal coverage for diagramming needs while maximizing both AI compatibility and professional output quality. Mermaid excels at simple, version-controlled UML diagrams that AI can easily generate, while Draw.io handles complex BPMN and custom diagrams requiring advanced layout control.
page_texts.16:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#implementation]

### Implementation

- **Timeline**: 4-month phased rollout
- **Key Steps**:
    1. Install Draw.io IDE extensions and establish templates
    2. Create Mermaid style guide and common patterns
    3. Convert existing high-priority diagrams
    4. Train teams on tool selection criteria and workflows
    5. Implement automated validation and rendering
- **Success Criteria**:
    - 95% of new diagrams follow the dual-tool standard
    - AI agents can generate Mermaid diagrams from requirements
    - Draw.io .drawio.png files render properly in all documentation platforms

---
page_texts.18:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#positive]

### Positive

- **Improved Version Control**: Both Mermaid text and Draw.io XML provide meaningful diffs
- **AI-Enhanced Diagramming**: Mermaid enables automatic diagram generation from specifications
- **Consistent Output**: Standardized tools and templates ensure visual consistency
- **Workflow Integration**: Diagrams integrate seamlessly with Markdown documentation workflow
- **Professional Quality**: Draw.io handles complex diagrams requiring fine layout control
page_texts.19:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#negative]

### Negative

- **Tool Complexity**: Teams must learn when and how to use each tool appropriately
- **Migration Effort**: Existing diagrams need conversion to new formats
- **Dependency Risk**: Relies on Draw.io IDE extension for optimal workflow
page_texts.20:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#neutral]

### Neutral

- **Tool Standardization**: Reduces from many tools to two specialized solutions
- **Format Shift**: Move from binary formats to text/XML-based approaches

---
page_texts.21:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#compliance-notes]

## Compliance Notes

- **Security**: Both tools integrate with existing Git security and access controls
- **Regulatory**: Diagram-as-code supports audit trails and compliance documentation
- **Standards**: Aligns with BPMN 2.0 and UML standards for business and technical modeling

---
page_texts.23:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#mermaid-integration]

### Mermaid Integration

````markdown
## System Architecture

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class UserService {
        +authenticate(credentials)
        +getUserProfile(id)
    }
    class AuthProvider {
        +validateToken(token)
    }
    UserService --> AuthProvider
```
````
page_texts.24:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-004-ea-diagram-standards.md#drawio-integration]

### Draw.io Integration

- Save files as `.drawio.png` format
- Install Draw.io extension in VS Code for inline editing
- Reference in Markdown: `![Process Flow](./diagrams/user-onboarding.drawio.png)`
- Files are both editable diagrams and renderable images
